key: folk:bull:The Eye in the Gale|dragon|storm|ash|The Kansas plains, 12:37 PM|

narrator.persona: a storm chaser recording his final log

sentences.text: Have you ever felt someone watching you from inside a wall of black wind?
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: My partner yelled over the roar of the engine to check the radar.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Look at how fast it shifted toward us!
sentences.speaker: person

sentences.text: The funnel stopped spinning like a normal storm and flattened out into a massive vertical tunnel.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Right through the revolving debris and green lightning, a pair of gigantic red eyes locked onto my windshield.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: It was not just wind tearing up the soil; it was a living colossus pulling the earth up into its throat.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Would you have stayed in your car once the sky turned around to hunt you?
sentences.speaker: narrator
